description: Cortical epithelial cells show self-peptides on MHC class II to developing T cells. Those whose receptor binds with the right strength survive and commit to the CD4 line, and leave the thymus as naive CD4 T cells; medullary epithelial cells then remove those that react too strongly. Most developing cells bind nothing and die. Selection acts on the developing cell, before it has the name naive CD4 T cell.
